verdict.rationale: The Agent Toolkit has a public GitHub repository (paypal/agent-toolkit) and is published on npm, so part of the agentic-commerce surface has readable source. The core services are documented only as PayPal-hosted, gated offerings with no published source: Store Sync, the cart reverse API, Agent Ready and the remote MCP server. Missing for 10: any evidence of the toolkit's license terms (open or otherwise), source for the hosted agentic-commerce services and the remote MCP server, and independent confirmation of openness.
